items.title: Simon Willison builds a blog feature almost entirely by voice with Codex
items.summary_en: Independent engineer Simon Willison describes building a new Newsletters page for his blog almost entirely by talking to a coding agent (Codex), then finishing the review by typing. It is a small, concrete field report on voice-driven agentic coding rather than a benchmark claim.
items.notes: Post not fetched (DNS). Summary relies on a search description; unverified against full text. Author is a named, well-known engineer.

items.title: Argument: pay-by-usage services should default to hard budget caps
items.summary_en: Simon Willison argues that usage-billed cloud and AI services should ship with hard spending limits by default, not just warning emails. According to the search description, he cites AWS's recent launch of spending limits as a sign of progress. This matters for agent and API workloads where runaway loops can create large bills.
items.notes: Post not fetched; search description only. AWS detail unverified. Mild push against the industry default rather than a strongly contrarian thesis.
